{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
# Identify QA rows: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
# Filter: loyal customers AND completed orders AND not QA
loyal_completed = df.loc[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed') & ~qa_mask]
# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
# Verify premises
assert 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' customer segment does not exist in the data"
assert 'completed' in df['status'].unique(), "'completed' status does not exist in the data"
mean_revenue"}
